veranderings.blok: Drie stories wat mense mekaar vertel
veranderings.voor: Mense het hulle lank gelede al vertel en elkeen
veranderings.na: Mense het hulle al lank gelede vertel, en elkeen
veranderings.rede: 'al lank gelede' is the natural order, and AWS needs a comma because both clauses have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Tselane en die stem by die deur
veranderings.voor: Mense by 'n ander dorp
veranderings.na: Mense in 'n ander dorp
veranderings.rede: People live 'in' a village in Afrikaans; 'by 'n dorp' reads as 'near a village' (preposition).

veranderings.voor: Sy weier hulle albei en sy gee
veranderings.na: Sy wys hulle albei af, en sy gee
veranderings.rede: 'weier' normally takes the thing refused, not the person, so 'wys af' is the idiomatic verb; the comma follows AWS for two full clauses.

vlae.blok: Tselane en die stem by die deur
vlae.teks: Dimo tel die sak later op en stap verder sonder om te weet.
vlae.rede: 'sonder om te weet' has no object, so the reader is not told what Dimo does not know (presumably that Tselane is no longer in the sack); fixing it means guessing the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
